funding.raw: [$250] Focus mode: single-expense report with a new comment stays hidden after Clear cache and restart

admission.agent_reason: Expensify/App's documented US$250 bounty programme (a [$N] title funded through the Upwork job that melvin-bot[bot] attests on the issue) covers this open bug in src/hooks/useSidebarOrderedReports.tsx.
admission.scope_quote: In Focus mode, a single-expense report with a new unread comment stays hidden from the LHN and the Unread tab after **Settings > Troubleshoot > Clear cache and restart**. The report shows as unread only after the user opens it.

commercial_review.reason: Expensify pays its [$N] Search/App bugs through a documented Upwork job programme; melvin-bot[bot] published the Upwork attestation on this issue and the repository merges constantly, so the offer is current, authority is the repository's own programme automation, the scope is a bounded source-level fix and no unpaid-work allegation or withdrawal appears in the collected sources.
